text: Main Courses: Intermediate Chinese Course, Intermediate spoken Chinese, Intermediate Listening Course, Newspapers Reading, Writing, and HSK for both intermediate and advanced tests. Features: Focus on practicing Sentence patterns and Intermediate listening and spoken Chinese.Focus on practicing Sentence patterns and Intermediate listening and spoken Chinese.
